subject: 坊巷院落
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY the camera projection and rectangular footprint geometry of this standalone Southern Song building sprite; keep materials, architectural design, historical style, doorway orientation, upper-left light and colors. Exact 2:1 orthographic dimetric: yaw45, elevation30; both ground edges must make 26.565 degrees with horizontal (slope +0.500 and -0.500), not the steeper 30-degree floor lines of generic isometric art. Ground is one flat uninterrupted rectangular 10 by 8 unit footprint, with no offsets or stepped outline. The left-to-front ground edge is 10 units, and front-to-right edge is 8 units, so down-right horizontal length divided by up-right horizontal length must equal 1.2500. In particular make down-right edge visibly longer than up-right edge. Clear thin footprint boundary, no raised plinth. Full building uncut with 12% transparent empty margins. Output true transparent RGBA with clean alpha, no background or glow, no writing, no people.
negative: 文字、标牌字、水印、人物、天空、地平线、背景色、棋盘格、厚地台、大阴影、现代物、清代形制、透视消失点、裁切屋檐、卡通。

references.role: edit target：定向调整相机和占地几何，保留建筑材质

created_time_basis: copy2保留的源PNG文件mtime；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 新图经audit独立view与量点，底面双轴+.575/-.574比首版更对称，仍有严格2:1残差；选新版。材质、左上光、S门左下、无字无人物、透明轮廓完整。
